classification.difficultyReason: Read quartile positions off a box plot and convert regions (Q3 to median, Q1 to Q3, above Q1) to 25%, 50%, 75% of 840. Single group, direct percent-of-total, no combining of separate groups.

content.prompt: The box plot shows the lengths of 840 barramundi caught in a fishing competition. How many fish were:

answer.worked:
From the median to the upper quartile is $25\%$ of the fish.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number}&=840\times0.25\\&=210\end{align*}$$

From the lower quartile to the upper quartile is $50\%$ of the fish.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number}&=840\times0.5\\&=420\end{align*}$$

From the lower quartile to the maximum is $75\%$ of the fish.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Number}&=840\times0.75\\&=630\end{align*}$$
